dedupe_keys.name: imptc infrastructure multi person trajectory dataset

description: IMPTC infrastructure multi person trajectory dataset provides traffic trajectories and contextual observations from an instrumented urban intersection, including vulnerable road users, vehicles, weather and traffic-light status. The provider is KAV Institute / TH Aschaffenburg. Geographical and temporal coverage: The German intersection dataset includes sequences recorded with cameras and LiDAR at 25 Hz. It distinguishes sequence-focused and trajectory-focused releases. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is Non-commercial research dataset; repository code has Apache-2.0 licence. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: Counts differ between the paper abstract and the release tables. No single total is asserted here. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
